question: On bounce, does proximity to the 52-week low (lower pct_52wl = near max capitulation) produce a better or worse stop-based R than stocks well above their 52w low? Pre-call: expect WORSE (falling-knife risk dominates) rather than better, since 52w-low proximity signals structural weakness, not just short-term oversold.
plain: Tests whether stocks near their 52-week low bounce better (max capitulation) or worse (falling knife) than stocks further above their yearly low.
